components.name: Chart/Cluster map
components.description: Embedding / segmentation view: each dot is an item projected to 2D (UMAP, t-SNE), colour = cluster, soft hull at layer opacity 10%. Labeled adds AI-generated cluster names. Axes have no meaning — never show tick values; say what was projected in the caption. React: <ClusterMap points={[{ x, y, cluster }]} clusters={[{ id, label }]} />
